seed: A cut inside one recording names its two sides the way the timeline does. At Next defaults, nothing switched on by hand: open the sample recording, cut it in two with Command K at a quarter of the way in, click the cut with the pointer, and the panel's Edit point reads Out: Sample Talk and In: Sample Talk, the name both bars on V1 carry (it read Piece 1 and Piece 2 until 2026-10-06, names no bar shows). Then a recording whose name is far longer than a field is opened, cut with the blade (B and a click at two seconds) and its cut clicked with the select tool (V), and both fields still sit on one line, giving way in the middle.
